question: How much notice should someone give for three business days of PTO?

gold.text: - Discuss planned time off with your manager first and provide as much notice as possible, but at least twice as many days as your planned time off (e.g., 6 business days notice for 3 days off).

question: Does a four-day sick absence normally require a sick note?

gold.text: 1. If your absence is less than 6 consecutive days, then you do not need to provide a sick note (unless your statutory reporting requirements state otherwise)

question: What training does a new internal interviewer need to finish before joining an interview team?

gold.text: New internal interviewers must complete the [interviewer training module in Level Up](https://levelup.csod.com/samldefault.aspx?ouid=1&returnUrl=%252fDeepLink%252fProcessRedirect.aspx%253fmodule%253dlodetails%2526lo%253d5c9f6b01-8189-418a-bb52-30b2c6d42b96), or as a part of the [Becoming a GitLab Manager issue template](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-com/people-group/Training/-/blob/master/.gitlab/issue_templates/becoming-a-gitlab-manager.md).

question: How quickly should a newly submitted employee referral be reviewed?

gold.text: - You can expect Referrals to be reviewed by the Hiring Team within **5 business days** of their submission.

question: What should an onboarding buddy arrange first for a new teammate?

gold.text: 1. **The first and most important thing a buddy should do is schedule a call with the GitLab team-member.**

question: When is a departing employee's system access normally deactivated on their final workday?

heading_path: When will my access be deactivated?
gold.text: Your access will be deactivated on your last day at 4pm (local time) on Monday-Friday

question: 计划一次休假超过 25 个连续日历日时，需要取得哪些人的特别批准？

gold.text: - GitLab does not set a specific limit on the amount of PTO a team member can take per year. However, for time off exceeding 25 consecutive calendar days (including weekends and holidays), special permission is required from your Manager, People Business Partner, and the Absence Management Team at leaves@gitlab.com.

question: GitLab 内部的试用期流程由哪个团队负责，他们要处理哪些事项？

gold.text: The People Operations Team is responsible for managing the probationary period process internally (communication with the team member, their manager, confirmation of probationary period completion, and updating Workday). In some instances, the People Operations Team may also be responsible for managing relationships with legal counsel externally on a global scale to ensure compliance and iteration.

question: GitLab 的 Q2 和 Q4 正式晋升周期分别在哪一天生效？

gold.text:
- **Q2 Cycle:** Promotions effective May 1
- **Q4 Cycle:** Promotions effective November 1

question: 员工休假结束刚回归时，应该怎样和经理安排恢复工作节奏？

gold.text: - Align with your manager on a ramp-up timeline. Remember, catching up takes time, ramping up gradually is normal and expected!
